hypotheses.persona: A single professional who works from home or has a home office, with a consistent weekday routine of morning work, lunch, and evening relaxation. Weekend routine shows later mornings and more leisure activities.
hypotheses.rationale: Thursday's events continue the strong weekday pattern: reading glasses at table at 07:09 (morning breakfast/reading), bed pillow at bed at 13:30 (midday rest, possibly a nap or making the bed), waste bin at counter at 14:04 (afternoon kitchen cleanup), wall clock at TV stand at 18:28 (evening entertainment setup), fork at sink at 18:41 (post-dinner cleanup). No doormat event suggests a work-from-home day. The pattern is highly consistent with a single professional.
